elements.element: Customer owns Deliverables and work product created for Customer.
elements.evidence: The inserted clause only grants Client a licence ("TrueLink grants Client a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free license to use, modify and sublicense ... all deliverables and work product"); no ownership vests in Client.

elements.element: Vendor assigns the Deliverables and work product to Customer.
elements.evidence: No assignment language anywhere; the redline is a licence-back approach only.

elements.element: Vendor retains its pre-existing intellectual property.
elements.evidence: Section 2(d) retained: "TrueLink retains all of its ownership and license rights in the Interface."

elements.element: Customer's licence to Vendor IP embedded in Deliverables is perpetual.
elements.evidence: New clause grants a "perpetual" licence to all deliverables and work product, which carries any TrueLink IP embedded in them.

elements.element: Customer's licence to embedded Vendor IP is irrevocable.
elements.evidence: New clause: "perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free license" over deliverables/work product.

elements.element: Customer's licence to embedded Vendor IP is royalty-free.
Customer retains all rights in Customer Data.
elements.evidence: No sentence stating Client retains all rights in Credit Data or other Client data; the redline only narrows the licence Client grants TrueLink.

elements.element: Any Vendor licence in Customer Data is limited to processing it solely to provide the Services.
elements.evidence: Section 8(d) as amended: licence to "use, upload, display, copy and store Credit Data solely to process it to provide the services under this Agreement"; distribute, disseminate, license, resell and exploit are deleted.

elements.element: The parties do not jointly own intellectual property.
elements.evidence: Condition does not arise: no joint-ownership language exists in the cited provisions (2(d) keeps the Interface with TrueLink; the new clause is a licence only), so nothing creates co-ownership.

elements.element: Vendor may retain ownership of generic tools and know-how.
elements.evidence: Retained section 2(d): "Notwithstanding the license granted under section 2.1, TrueLink retains all of its ownership and license rights in the Interface." The permissive element is satisfied and the redline does not disturb it.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Deliverables is perpetual.
elements.evidence: Inserted clause: "TrueLink grants Client a perpetual ... license ... all deliverables and work product prepared for Client under this Agreement, including the results of the Support Services."

elements.element: Customer's licence to Deliverables is irrevocable.
Customer's licence to Deliverables is worldwide.
Customer's licence to Deliverables is royalty-free.
Customer may use and modify Deliverables for its business.
elements.evidence: Inserted clause: licence "to use, modify and sublicense for its business" all deliverables and work product.

elements.element: Customer may sublicense Deliverables for its business.
elements.evidence: Same clause expressly grants the right to "sublicense for its business".

elements.element: Any Vendor licence in Customer Data is limited to processing it solely to provide the Services.
elements.evidence: Amended 8(d) removes the distribute/disseminate/license/resell/exploit rights and confines the remaining verbs to processing "solely to ... provide the services under this Agreement"; no other Vendor data licence appears (section 10 is confidentiality only).

reasons: Fallback checklist is complete: the inserted deliverables licence supplies all five licence attributes plus use, modify and sublicense for Client's business, and the amended section 8(d) confines TrueLink's Credit Data licence to processing to provide the services, curing the independent-exploitation defect (distribute, disseminate, license, resell, exploit deleted).

Preferred level is not reached: there is no Customer ownership of, or Vendor assignment of, deliverables and work product, and no express statement that Client retains all rights in its data. If the drafter wants the preferred position, insert (i) "All deliverables and work product prepared for Client are the property of Client and TrueLink hereby assigns all right, title and interest therein to Client" and (ii) "Client retains all right, title and interest in Credit Data and all other Client data."

Minimality holds: the only deletions are the exploitation verbs required by the data element, the Non-Competition Agreement limitation and TrueLink's Interface ownership are preserved, and the deliverables grant is a concise insertion for an absent licence with no survival tails, expense or damages extras. The "including the results of the Support Services" tail is borderline explanatory but is doing work here because the Agreement defines no "Deliverables" and the Support Services output is the principal work product; consider deleting it if a strict reading is preferred.

Intent preserved: the Credit Data definition, the Support Services mechanics, section 2(d) ownership and the Non-Competition Agreement cross-reference all survive without contradiction, and no new undefined term or dangling reference is created (the inserted clause should be given a section letter/number for cleanliness).
